events.verdict: Marshall (DAL) closely guards Grimes (PHI) near midcourt and the contact initiated by Marshall is marginal.
Christie (DAL) raises his arms into a vertical position as he contests the driving shot attempt and the ensuing contact with Grimes' (PHI) arm after the release is incidental.
Butler (PHI) absorbs the contact initiated by Washington (DAL) during his drive to the basket.
Christie (DAL) makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge it from Council IV's (PHI) possession and any ensuing contact is considered incidental.
Council IV (PHI) reaches in and makes clean contact with the ball to deflect it away from Thompson (DAL).
Washington (DAL) maintains a legal guarding position during Grimes' (PHI) towards the basket and jump shot attempt.
Replay review of the foul called on Marshall (DAL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Marshall makes illegal contact to Grimes' (PHI) arm before he gets to the ball.
Christie (DAL) commits a take foul on Butler (PHI).
Hood-Schifino (PHI) places his arms at Christie's (DAL) sides, but the contact is marginal and he is allowed to move freely.
Butler (PHI) contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making contact with Dinwiddie's (DAL) arm.
Dinwiddie (DAL) commits a take foul on Hood-Schifino (PHI).
